questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Asunción?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Paraguay is Asunción.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Paraguay?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Paraguay on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Paraguay article.

questions.proof: It is bordered to the North and East by Brazil, the West by Bolivia, and the South and Southeast by Argentina.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Paraguay about 406,756 square kilometres; Panama about 74,177 square kilometres; Switzerland about 41,291 square kilometres; Solomon Islands about 28,400 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Paraguay?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Paraguay is the Paraguayan guaraní.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Paraguay on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Paraguay on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
